detail.longDescription: I'm using GitHub with a GitHub Copilot license, and we have JaCoCo code coverage integrated into our Java Maven builds. Current flow: A developer creates a feature branch (e.g. feature/ABC ) from develop . Changes are made to Java files in feature/ABC . A Pull Request is raised from feature/ABC → develop . The PR pipeline runs automatically and generates JaCoCo coverage reports. As part of the PR build, I'm looking for a workflow like this: Detect whether any .java files were modified in the PR. If Java files were changed, check the JaCoCo coverage generated by the build (for example, 45% coverage). Use AI (Copilot, GitHub Models, etc.) to generate unit tests for the modified Java classes with the goal of increasing coverage by at least 1-2%. Create a new branch automatically (for example, auto-tests-feature-ABC ). Commit the generated test cases to that branch. Automatically create a PR from auto-tests-feature-ABC → feature/ABC . Assign or request review from the author of feature/ABC .
